name: jules-delegate
description: Delegate scoped GitHub coding tasks to Google Jules with Codex skills and MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate scoped implementation tasks to Google Jules
interface.longDescription: Use Codex as an orchestrator and Google Jules as an asynchronous coding implementer for connected GitHub repositories. Includes a focused skill, prompt policy, and MCP tools for create/watch/approve/result/patch flows.
defaultPrompt: Use Jules Delegate to create a Jules session for a scoped bug fix and wait for plan approval.
Use Jules Delegate to fetch the result and patch from an existing Jules session.
